title: cross-functional-planning-retreat-annotated-agenda-v0-1
content:
Purpose: run a focused half-day cross-functional planning retreat to align Q2 initiatives, surface risk, and produce a starter OKR set for leadership and team discussion. Not a final OKR doc; this is a working planning session + annotated running notes for follow-ups.

Key objectives (what we must leave with):
- Shared north star for Q2 (1 paragraph).
